raw_context:
Panvel
is famous as
the
Gateway to the Konkan region
, a major railway hub, and a popular trekking and nature destination in Maharashtra surrounded by the Sahyadri mountains
Bajaj Finserv
Key Attractions and Heritage
Karnala Fort & Bird Sanctuary
A historic hill fort famous for scenic treks and protecting diverse migratory bird species.
Kalavantin Durg
Renowned for having one of the most thrilling, steep rock-cut pinnacle staircases and trekking routes in the country.
Ancient Temples
Close proximity to spiritual sites like the 400-year-old
Ballaleshwar Ashtavinayak Temple
in Pali and the historic
Khandeshwar Shiva Temple
Tripadvisor
Modern Significance
Transport Hub:
Home to one of India's major railway junctions connecting Mumbai, Pune, and South India.
Industrial & Urban Growth:
A rapidly developing node of Navi Mumbai close to major industrial zones (MIDC)
and the upcoming
Navi Mumbai International Airport
